'''Rakata Energy Cubes''' were a technology developed by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] and were similar to a [[Datacron/Legends|Datacron]] but instead held large quantities of energy. However, only [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] technology was able to properly harness the power of an Energy Cube.
